item.title: Mitsotakis unveils plans to expand Evros border fence
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis has announced plans to extend the Evros border fence to cover the entire length of Greece’s frontier with Turkey. item.description: The Consul General of Greece in Sydney, George Skemperis, met on Wednesday, February 25 with His Eminence Archbishop Makarios of Australia in a meeting focused on strengthening cooperation for the benefit of the Greek diaspora in Australia.
